text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its prospects and role in my portfolio, not just whether it is above or below my average cost.","Selling Stock A at a gain felt comfortable, but a realized profit alone does not show that selling was the best decision; I should use consistent reasons for selling winners and losers.","A few months of gains or losses are not enough to justify a reaction. I should review the whole portfolio periodically and make deliberate changes only when my goals or the investment case warrant them."]}
